category: product analytics, session replay, feature flags and error tracking

free_tier.stated: Free every month, reset monthly, with or without a card on file: 1M analytics events, 5K session recordings, 1M feature flag requests, 100K exceptions, 1500 survey responses; 1 project, 1-year data retention, unlimited team members; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: Each product has its own monthly count (events, recordings, flag requests, exceptions, survey responses), so no single unit of the vocabulary fits; all are counts of requests. Usage across projects shares one free allowance. On the free plan, events past the allowance are permanently dropped and feature flags return a quota-limited response, so usage stops rather than bills.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no event size limit is stated on the pages read

retention.stated: Events and metadata: 1 year on a free plan (7 years on paid). Session recordings: 1 month on the free plan. Logs: 14 days by default.
retention.notes: After 1 year data may move to cold storage, and data past its retention period may be deleted.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress term on the pages read; data is read back through the private API, rate limited per personal API key (240/minute and 1200/hour on analytics endpoints)

interface_detail: Public POST-only endpoints (event capture at /i/v0/e, flag evaluation at /flags) take a project token and are not rate limited; private GET, POST, PATCH and DELETE endpoints take a personal API key or OAuth. The US app host us.posthog.com answered 401 to /api/projects/ without a key. The data region (US or EU) is fixed when the account is made.
tooling: PostHog SDKs, the @posthog/wizard command (run with npx), which can create the account and install the SDK, and any HTTP client with a personal API key for the private API
chaining: Event capture and feature flags for the front end of a free-hosted app, up to 1M events a month, with error tracking in the same project; over the allowance events are dropped, not billed.

limits.value: 1M analytics events per month; further events are permanently dropped on the free plan
5K session recordings, 1M feature flag requests, 100K exceptions and 1500 survey responses per month; 1 project
240 per minute and 1200 per hour on analytics endpoints, per personal API key
events 1 year, session recordings 1 month on the free plan

binding_note: Events past 1M in a month are permanently dropped on the free plan, so the monthly event count is the first ceiling for an app with traffic; the API rate applies only to reads with a personal key.

identity_cost.detail: An account is tied to an e-mail address: the wizard creates one from an e-mail address and a region. The pricing and sign-up pages state no credit card is required, and the allowance is the same with or without a card on file. Whether a later step asks for a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Events above the free allowance are permanently dropped and feature flags return a quota-limited response.
confidence_note: Every limit is quoted from a first-party page, and the private API host answered 401 without a key. No account was opened; an authenticated query from a free project would move it to measured.

notes: The free plan stops at its limits instead of billing, so an app sending more than 1M events a month loses the excess. Moving to pay-as-you-go needs a card and raises the project count to 6 and event retention to 7 years.
